name: team_rookies
caption:
IF OUR YOUNG CORE WERE POKÉMON 🎮🏀

🐦 Ja'Kobe Walter = Fletchling: easy to train, ferocious in battle. The 19th pick in 2024, then a game-winner with 0.5 seconds left
🐼 Collin Murray-Boyles = Pancham: grows up imitating the leader it looks up to. The 9th pick in 2025, first Raptor ever with 17 points, 15 boards, 3 blocks and 3 steals in a game
🐶 Allen Graves = Rockruff: friendly, but rougher as it grows up. Our youngest at 20, and one growth spurt took him from 6'1 to 6'7
🦝 Jamal Shead = Sneasel: hidden claws, hidden ability Pickpocket. The 45th pick, after Big 12 Player and Defensive Player of the Year in the same season
🐉 Scottie Barnes = Dragonite: flies over the seas rescuing people. The 4th pick in 2021, Rookie of the Year in 2022

That's a team we're taking into any gym in the league. Who would you change? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

It grows up imitating Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.

facts.claim: June 26, 2024: Walter selected with the 19th overall pick (#19) by Toronto; March 4, 2025: hit a three with 0.5 seconds left for a 114-113 win over Orlando

Murray-Boyles chosen ninth overall (#9) in the 2025 NBA draft by Toronto; recorded 17 points, 15 rebounds, 3 blocks and 3 steals (17-15-3-3) vs Philadelphia, the first player in Raptors history to achieve those numbers in a game
A growth spurt over one summer took Graves from 6 ft 1 in (6'1) to 6 ft 7 in (6'7); selected 19th overall by Toronto in 2026
Raptors roster: Allen Graves, age 20, is the youngest player (next youngest Collin Murray-Boyles, 21)

Shead: Big 12 Player of the Year (POY) and Defensive Player of the Year (DPOY), the first player to win both in the same season; selected 45th overall (#45) in the 2024 NBA draft, traded on draft night to Toronto
Barnes: selected with the fourth overall pick (#4) in the 2021 NBA draft; NBA Rookie of the Year in 2022
